name: pi
description: pi: a minimal, extensible agent harness (unified LLM API / agent loop / TUI / coding agent CLI), customized with extensions, skills, prompt templates and themes, and distributed as Pi packages over npm or git. It does not implement A2A or publish an Agent Card; programmatic integration uses RPC mode (JSONL records over stdin/stdout), so the endpoint is expressed as stdio://pi to convey that intent. This entry is kept as a control group showing how a non-A2A asset is registered.

metadata.install: curl -fsSL https://pi.dev/install.sh | sh (or install Node.js 22.19+ with nvm)
metadata.a2a: unsupported — no Agent Card is published; see example/README_cn.md for how the control group is marked
metadata.env_hint: Provider credentials are configured inside Pi with /login, not written into this JSON
